# kirillovec AI Creative Studio

> kirillovec.ru is a Russian-language creative workspace focused on audio, image, video and text creation.

## Main tools
- https://kirillovec.ru/studio/?mode=audio — Audio workshop: lyrics structure, Style Builder, Suno prompt pack, Weirdness and Style Influence notes, copy-and-open workflow.
- https://kirillovec.ru/studio/?mode=image — Image generation and reference-based editing through configured Cloudflare Workers AI models.
- https://kirillovec.ru/studio/?mode=video — Video prompt builder for Text to Video and Image to Video with external provider handoff.
- https://kirillovec.ru/studio/?mode=text — Text templates and structured prompt drafting for songs, poems, scripts, ads and descriptions.
- https://kirillovec.ru/ — Main AI Creative Studio homepage.
- https://kirillovec.ru/account/ — Account and user settings.
- https://kirillovec.ru/artist/ — Secondary artist profile and music releases.
- https://kirillovec.ru/творчество/ — Secondary creative portfolio.
- https://kirillovec.ru/referrals/ — External creative-service referrals.

## Product priorities
1. Audio workshop: Suno-ready Style/Lyrics builder, song structure, vocal and production presets, copy/open handoff and downloadable prompt packs. Audio API generation remains disabled unless separately approved for cost.
2. Image generation and image editing with reference uploads, aspect-ratio workflows and direct result downloads.
3. Video concepts, storyboard prompts and transparent handoff to external video services; in-site rendering is not currently enabled.
4. Text workshop for lyrics, poems, scripts, ads, descriptions and reusable AI prompts.
5. Unified browser-local project library, editable drafts, JSON backup and downloads.

## Product positioning
- This is an AI Creative Studio first, not an artist portfolio.
- Audio and image creation are the two lead tools; video and text are supporting creation tools.
- Artist releases and portfolio pages are secondary destinations.

## Capability and cost transparency
- Suno handoff mode copies Style, Lyrics, title and settings into the clipboard and opens Suno. This does not require a Suno API key; Suno account limits and terms apply.
- The server-side Suno API route exists in the backend, but the Studio UI keeps it disabled by default because the third-party provider may charge. The no-API-key manual handoff is the default workflow.
- Image generation depends on Cloudflare Workers AI binding availability, model availability and account limits.
- Image-to-image accepts JPEG, PNG and WEBP references subject to the site's upload limit.
- Video generation is not rendered by the site at this time. The Studio prepares prompts and links to external video services; their pricing, credits and availability are controlled by those services.
- Text workspace currently provides editable structures and prompt templates locally. It does not claim server-side AI text generation until a text model provider is configured.
- Project saves and project export are browser-local. Clearing browser site data can remove local projects; users should export backups.
- R2 is not required for current inline image processing and must not be enabled without a separate cost review.

## Language and audience
- Primary language: Russian.
- Audience: musicians, creators, independent artists and people creating audio, images, video and text.

## Contact and ownership
- Project name: kirillovec.
